name: apksig-android
sourceMaintenanceNote: Android fork master latest source commit observed 2023-05-01. The old source models Android signature behavior through API 33. It is not the latest AOSP verifier.
extraction: Unmodified classes.jar extracted from the published AAR. No code decompilation or source alteration.
runtimeDependencies: Android framework and Java platform classes only. No Bouncy Castle or network service is required.
apiPolicy: Invoke only public ApkVerifier and DataSource APIs. Check the current platform capped at API 33. Devices above API 33 always retain UNKNOWN_PLATFORM as their final signature status even if the engine verifies under its API 33 model. Unsupported algorithms, read errors and resource limits remain unknown.
limitations: Authenticity of the publisher is not established by APK cryptographic validity. Local OS compromise can mislead file and PackageManager observations.
